signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Manage challenge domains, API keys and hosted zones.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Your account comes with a global API key for ACME clients.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Your challenge domains, hosted zones and keys at a glance.

quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.description: Three steps to DNS-01 certificates without exposing your zone.

step1.title: Add a challenge domain
step1.text: Register the domain you request certificates for; certo assigns it a unique CNAME target.
step1.label: Domains

step2.title: Point the CNAME at it
step2.text: At your DNS provider, create _acme-challenge.<domain> CNAME <target>. The Domains page checks it for you.
step2.label: Check CNAME

step3.title: Configure your ACME client
step3.text: Use an API key with lego, Traefik, Caddy, acme.sh or cert-manager; the Clients page has ready-made snippets.
step3.label: Clients

password.title: Change password
password.description: Existing sessions and API keys keep working.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Removes your API keys, challenge domains, published tokens and hosted zones. Certificates already issued stay valid, but renewals through this account stop.
delete.dialogDescription: This cannot be undone. Hosted zones stop resolving immediately.

domains.title: Challenge domains
domains.description: Each domain gets a CNAME target; ACME clients write their DNS-01 tokens there.

addDialog.title: Add domain
addDialog.description: The domain you request certificates for. A CNAME from its _acme-challenge name to the target shown afterwards completes the setup.
addDialog.label: Domain
addDialog.hint: Wildcards and subdomains of this name use the same CNAME.

empty.title: No domains yet
empty.description: Add a domain to get its CNAME target, or let a global API key create it on first use.

card.title: Domains
card.description: Expand a row to see its published tokens; check the CNAME after setting it up.

remove.label: Remove {{domain}}
remove.title: Remove {{domain}}?
remove.description: Its challenge records are deleted and clients using the CNAME stop working.

domains.dnsRecord: DNS record to add at your provider
domains.noTokens: None right now; they appear while a client validates a challenge.

records.title: Active TXT records
records.description: Tokens currently published for your domains; they refresh every 15 seconds.
records.name: Name

created.title: {{domain}} added
created.description: Create this record at your DNS provider, then use "Check CNAME" on the domain row.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Keys authenticate ACME clients (httpreq and acme-dns). A scoped key only reaches the domains it lists.

dialog.title: Create API key
dialog.name: Name
dialog.hint: *.example.com covers the domain and its subdomains, example.com the exact name. Leave empty for a global key.

empty.title: No API keys
empty.description: Create a key to configure an ACME client.

delete.label: Delete key {{name}}
delete.title: Delete key "{{name}}"?
delete.description: Clients using this key stop working immediately.

created.title: Key "{{name}}" created
created.description: Copy it into your ACME client. It stays visible on this page, so you can come back for it.
created.snippets: Show client snippets with this key

clients.title: Client setup
clients.description: Point your ACME client at this server with one of your API keys.
clients.selectKeyHint: Select an API key above to fill in {{placeholder}}.

protocolNote.httpreq: lego's HTTP request provider: the client posts each challenge to this server with your username and API key.
protocolNote.acmedns: The acme-dns protocol, understood by many clients. Your username and API key are the acme-dns credentials; the CNAME is the same as for httpreq.

note.httpreqTraefik: Traefik embeds lego; the resolver uses the httpreq provider with the same variables.
note.httpreqUnsupported: {{client}} has no httpreq integration; use the acme-dns protocol instead.
note.acmednsLego: The storage URL carries your username and API key, so accounts are fetched and domains created automatically; there is no local JSON to pre-seed.
note.acmednsCaddy: Build Caddy with the acmedns module (xcaddy build --with github.com/caddy-dns/acmedns) and reference the account file.
note.acmednsAcmesh: Set the account details once; acme.sh stores them in its config for renewals.
note.acmednsCertmanager: The Secret holds the acme-dns account JSON; one entry per domain.

zones.title: Hosted zones
zones.description: Authoritative forward and reverse zones. Delegate a zone to {{ns}} and it is served after the next check.

empty.title: No zones yet
empty.description: Add a zone to host its records here.

addDialog.title: Add zone
addDialog.description: A forward zone (example.com) or a reverse zone (23.251.162.in-addr.arpa).
addDialog.label: Zone name
addDialog.hint: The zone is served once its parent delegates it with an NS record to {{ns}}. Checks run hourly; you can also trigger one.

zones.exempted: {{zone}} is served without a delegation check
zones.unexempted: {{zone}} returns to the normal check cycle

delete.label: Delete zone {{zone}}
delete.title: Delete {{zone}}?
delete.description: All records, keys and transfer settings of the zone are removed and it stops resolving.

detail.waitingText: At the parent (registrar or address block owner), add an NS record for {{zone}} pointing at {{ns}}. The zone is checked hourly and served once the delegation is found.
detail.failingText: {{count}} consecutive failed checks; the zone stops being served after 7.

records.title: Records
records.description: Grouped by name and type; SOA is maintained by the server.
records.filter: Filter by name, type or content…

empty.title: No records
empty.description: Add records one set at a time or import a zone file.

records.deleteDescription: All records of this name and type are removed.

rrset.editDescription: All records of this name and type are replaced.
rrset.addDescription: One record per line; the same name and type form one set.
rrset.name: Name
rrset.nameHint: Relative to {{zone}}; @ is the zone itself.
rrset.txtHint: Plain text; quotes are added for you.
rrset.absoluteHint: Names in record data must be absolute (with a trailing dot).
rrset.ttlNumber: TTL must be a whole number of seconds

import.title: Import records
import.description: Paste zone-file lines. Records of the same name and type replace the existing set; nothing else is deleted.
import.label: Zone file
import.hint: $ORIGIN and $TTL are honoured; names are relative to the zone. SOA lines are ignored.

reason.soa: the SOA is maintained by the server

dnssec.title: DNSSEC
dnssec.description: Signing with an ECDSA P-256 key; publish the DS record at the parent.
dnssec.disableDescription: Remove the DS record at the parent first, or resolvers will reject the zone.
dnssec.ds: DS records for the parent zone

transfer.title: Zone transfer (AXFR)
transfer.description: Secondaries may transfer the zone from the listed addresses or with a TSIG key.
transfer.allowHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges, one per line. Empty denies unsigned transfers.

created.title: TSIG key created
created.description: Copy the secret now; it is not shown again.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Users, every hosted zone, challenge domains, published tokens and the server configuration.

gate.title: Admin area

gate.hint: The api.admin_key value from the server configuration.

zones.hint: Toggle the exemption to serve a zone without a verified delegation. The base zone is always served.
